problems.quote: Introduced concept of federal structure — provinces given defined spheres.
problems.problem: The Government of India Act 1919 did not introduce a federal structure; it maintained a unitary system with dyarchy in provinces. Federal structure was introduced by the Government of India Act 1935.
problems.correction: Removed reference to federal structure; the 1919 Act introduced dyarchy in provinces and a central legislature but not a federal system.
problems.verifierReason: 1919 Act introduced dyarchy, not federalism; federal structure proposed in 1935 Act.

problems.quote: Reserve Bank of India — established under this act.
problems.problem: The Reserve Bank of India was established by the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, not by the Government of India Act 1935.
problems.correction: Reserve Bank of India — established under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
problems.verifierReason: RBI established by RBI Act 1934 (assented March 1934), not GoI Act 1935 (assented Aug 1935).

problems.quote: .15 trillion (nominal GDP, 2026)
problems.problem: India's nominal GDP in 2026 is projected around $3.5–4 trillion, not 0.15 trillion.
problems.correction: ~$3.5 trillion (nominal GDP, 2026)
problems.verifierReason: 0.15 trillion is far below any credible projection; IMF/WEO forecasts ~3.5 trillion USD for 2026.

problems.quote: MPI (India's MPI fell from 55% in 2005-06 to 25% in 2019-21
problems.problem: The multidimensional poverty headcount ratio in 2019-21 was ~16% (UNDP) or ~15% (NITI Aayog), not 25%.
problems.correction: MPI (India's MPI fell from 55% in 2005-06 to ~16% in 2019-21
problems.verifierReason: India's MPI was about 16 % in 2019‑21 (UNDP) or 15 % (NITI Aayog), not 25 %.

problems.quote: co-operative banks (since 2020 amendments)
problems.problem: Implies co-operative banks were brought under DICGC coverage only in 2020; they were already covered.
problems.correction: co-operative banks (cover increased to 5 lakh in 2020)
problems.verifierReason: Co-op banks already under DICGC pre-2020; 2020 amendment raised cover to ₹5 lakh, not brought them under coverage.

problems.quote: The NSE is the largest stock exchange in India and 4th largest globally by market cap (~)
problems.problem: NSE is not the 4th largest globally by market cap; it ranks around 7th-8th.
problems.correction: The NSE is the largest stock exchange in India and among the top 10 globally by market cap.
problems.verifierReason: NSE ranks ~7th-8th globally by market cap (2024), not 4th; 'top 10' is accurate.

problems.quote: elected members of municipalities and Panchayats
problems.problem: Article 243ZE specifies that two-thirds of MPC members are elected from among the elected members of Municipalities and Chairpersons of Panchayats, not all elected members of Panchayats.
problems.correction: elected members of Municipalities and Chairpersons of Panchayats
problems.verifierReason: Art. 243ZE mandates MPC members elected from elected members of Municipalities and Chairpersons of Panchayats.

problems.quote: The 74th Amendment recommended the Nagarpalika Bill 1992 which provided for a directly elected Mayor with a fixed 5-year term
problems.problem: The 74th Amendment (1992) added Part IXA but did not recommend any Nagarpalika Bill; a separate model bill proposed direct election of Mayor, which states have not fully adopted.
problems.correction: The 74th Amendment did not recommend a Nagarpalika Bill; a 1992 model bill proposed a directly elected Mayor with a 5-year term, but states have not fully implemented it.
problems.verifierReason: 74th Amendment added Part IXA; did not recommend Nagarpalika Bill. 1992 model bill proposed direct mayoral election, not fully adopted.

problems.quote: The Act also abolished Article 370.
problems.problem: The Jammu & Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2019 did not abolish Article 370; Article 370 was abrogated by the Constitution (Application to Jammu and Kashmir) Order, 2019, a Presidential order.
problems.correction: Article 370 was abrogated by a Presidential order; the Act reorganised the state.
problems.verifierReason: Act reorganised state; Art. 370 abrogated by Presidential Order C.O. 272 (2019).

problems.quote: about 200 million years ago, the Indian Plate broke away from Gondwanaland
problems.problem: The Indian Plate separated from Gondwanaland around 120-130 million years ago, not 200 million years ago.
problems.correction: about 120-130 million years ago, the Indian Plate broke away from Gondwanaland
problems.verifierReason: India separated from Gondwana ~120-130 Ma, not 200 Ma (geological consensus).

problems.quote: Source of the Indus, Ganga, and Brahmaputra.
problems.problem: The Indus and Brahmaputra originate in the Trans-Himalayas (Tibetan Plateau), not the Great Himalayas; only the Ganga originates in the Great Himalayas.
problems.correction: Source of the Ganga; the Indus and Brahmaputra originate in the Trans-Himalayas.
problems.verifierReason: Indus & Brahmaputra rise in Trans-Himalaya (Tibet); only Ganga in Great Himalaya.

problems.quote: Palghat Gap (the widest at 300 m)
problems.problem: Palghat Gap is about 30 km wide, not 300 m.
problems.correction: Palghat Gap (the widest at about 30 km)
problems.verifierReason: Palghat Gap is ~30 km wide, not 300 m (Survey of India data).

problems.quote: exposing the Sunda Shelf and creating land bridges between India and Sri Lanka
problems.problem: The Sunda Shelf is in Southeast Asia; the land bridge between India and Sri Lanka formed due to exposure of the continental shelf in the Palk Strait.
problems.correction: exposing the continental shelf and creating land bridges between India and Sri Lanka
problems.verifierReason: Sunda Shelf is in SE Asia; India-Sri Lanka bridge formed by exposure of Palk Strait continental shelf.

problems.quote: Elephas hysudrindicus
problems.problem: The correct species name for the extinct Indian elephant is Elephas hysudricus.
problems.correction: Elephas hysudricus
problems.verifierReason: Correct spelling is Elephas hysudricus; 'hysudrindicus' is a misspelling.

problems.quote: six-horned deer Hyaena carnivora
problems.problem: Hyaena carnivora is a hyena, not a deer. The six-horned deer is a different animal (e.g., Sivatherium).
problems.correction: six-horned deer (e.g., Sivatherium)
problems.verifierReason: Hyaena carnivora is a hyena; six-horned deer refers to Sivatherium, a giraffid.

problems.quote: Chairperson + 5 members
problems.problem: The National Commission for Minorities Act, 1992 provides for a Chairperson, a Vice-Chairperson, and five members (total seven), not just Chairperson and five members.
problems.correction: Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson, and five members
problems.verifierReason: NCM Act 1992 Sec 3(2) mandates Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson & 5 Members (total 7). Quote omits Vice-Chairperson.

problems.quote: Federalism 2
problems.problem: Incorrect count of federalism-themed essays in UPSC's last five years (2020-2024). Federalism appeared 0 times in this period (2016 had 2, 2017 had 1, but not in 2020-2024).
problems.correction: Federalism 0
problems.verifierReason: UPSC Essay papers 2020-2024 contain zero explicit federalism topics; 2016 had two, 2017 had one.

problems.quote: during the Gupta period Xuanzang reported they constituted a majority of Indian Buddhists
problems.problem: Xuanzang visited India in the 7th century CE, not during the Gupta period (4th–6th century CE).
problems.correction: in the 7th century Xuanzang reported they constituted a majority of Indian Buddhists
problems.verifierReason: Xuanzang visited India 629–645 CE, post-Gupta; correction fixes anachronism.

problems.quote: Fourth Council (c. 78-100 CE) : Two separate councils
problems.problem: The Theravada Fourth Council in Sri Lanka took place in the 1st century BCE (c. 29–17 BCE), not 78–100 CE. Only the Sarvastivada council under Kanishka falls in that range.
problems.correction: Fourth Council (Theravada c. 29-17 BCE, Sarvastivada c. 78-100 CE): Two separate councils
problems.verifierReason: Theravada 4th Council (Sri Lanka, 29–17 BCE) and Sarvastivada 4th Council (Kashmir, c. 78–100 CE) are distinct; original conflates dates.

problems.quote: The earliest representation of Shiva in anthropomorphic form is on the coins of Vima Kadphises (c. 80-100 CE)
problems.problem: The Gudimallam linga (c. 2nd century BCE) contains a standing anthropomorphic figure of Shiva, predating the Vima Kadphises coins by over a century.
problems.correction: The earliest representation of Shiva in anthropomorphic form is the Gudimallam linga (c. 2nd century BCE)
problems.verifierReason: Gudimallam linga (2nd cent. BCE) shows anthropomorphic Shiva, predating Vima Kadphises coins.

problems.quote: the Gupta king Chandragupta II's daughter Prabhavatigupta married a Shaka prince
problems.problem: Prabhavatigupta married Rudrasena II of the Vakataka dynasty, not a Shaka prince.
problems.correction: the Gupta king Chandragupta II's daughter Prabhavatigupta married the Vakataka king Rudrasena II
problems.verifierReason: Prabhavatigupta married Vakataka king Rudrasena II, not a Shaka prince.

problems.quote: Shakas / Western Kshatrapas (90 BCE-250 CE)
problems.problem: The Western Kshatrapa dynasty began in the 1st century CE (c. 35 CE), not 90 BCE. The date 90 BCE refers to earlier Shaka incursions, not the Western Kshatrapa dynasty.
problems.correction: Shakas / Western Kshatrapas (c. 35 CE–405 CE)
problems.verifierReason: Western Kshatrapas began c. 35 CE (Chashtana) and ended c. 405 CE (Gupta conquest).
